links.comparator_used: Standalone Llama3.2 without retrieval (training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Accuracy on 1,713 multiple-choice pediatric clinical questions (MedQA and ADC-Education and Practice)
links.effect: 67.78% (1,161/1,713) with RAG vs 46.18% (791/1,713) standalone; p = 1.5e-112; improvement consistent across all pediatric subspecialties
links.quote: The RAG-integrated system significantly outperformed standalone Llama3.2, achieving an overall accuracy of 67.78 % (1,161/1,713) compared to 46.18 % (791/1,713) for Llama3.2 alone (p = 1.5e-112).
